environment: Node VM + minimal DOM harness + native Canvas; not a browser
passed: Editor opens from the title with 618 locally drawn objects and all 18 maps, without creating or overwriting an adventure. Every default map passes continuous-edge reachability checks.
Real palette placement, pointer drag, coordinate inspector, rotated collisions, collision toggles, duplication, removal and undo/redo handlers work together.

Moving a usable bench rebuilds its reserved activity destination. Moving a vendor counter moves its work anchors and resident home; moving a hosted food interaction moves its counter. Campaign NPCs cannot be deleted.
Path painting, custom musical interaction, authored labels and a collision-aware walking preview work through UI handlers. Escape resumes editing; the visit does not advance quests.

Export/import preserves authored scenes and all 18 map profiles, excludes adventure data and rejects unknown assets, invalid coordinates, missing educational interactions and prototype keys. Drafts reopen; applied layouts use separate LocalStorage keys.

F2 opens during play; simulation and play time pause, save writes are suppressed, and visits to locked editor maps leave campaign progress unchanged. Added instruments play normally after application. Blocked layouts are rejected atomically, preserving portals, doors and characters.
Applied editor layouts survive reload and rebuilding alongside version-1 adventure saves; minimap cache keys include layout revisions.
limitations: CSS panel layout and real pointer capture, touch, file picker and browser audio require supported-browser verification.
